qa.title: Q404 (Dec. 8, 2023)
qa.question: If there are 2 enemy followers on the field, one with Aura and one without, can I still play the Combo part of this spell?
qa.answer: Yes. You can select the enemy follower without Aura, so you can play this spell. If you have a Combo of at least 5, each opponent puts each follower from their field on the top or bottom of its owner's deck, including the follower with Aura.

qa.title: Q403 (Dec. 8, 2023)
qa.question: If the only enemy follower on the field is one with Aura, like Heavenly Aegis, can I still play the Combo part of this spell?
qa.answer: No. If you can't select an enemy follower on the field, you can't play this spell.

qa.title: Q156 (Jun. 30, 2023)
qa.question: If my Combo is 5, and my opponent has to put 2 or more followers into their deck, do they get to decide the order and number of cards they put on the top or bottom of the deck?
qa.answer: Yes. They may decide the order and placement of each card.
